meta: Plan a month of video posts with AI so you never run out of ideas or wake up wondering what to post today.

muc.title: Quitting for lack of ideas
muc.text: Many small channels quit after a few weeks, not from laziness, but from wondering every morning what to post.

muc.title: One big idea, many parts
muc.text: Mark học AI works in series of five or six parts, so one big topic covers a whole week.

muc.title: A thirty-day table
muc.text: Give your list of ideas to a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask for a thirty-day schedule mixing easy and hard topics.

muc.title: A stash of spare ideas
muc.text: Ask AI for a list of backup ideas too, so on busy days you still have something to post without rushing.

muc.title: Four series for next month
muc.text: Tell a chatbot your channel's topic and ask it to split it into four series for the next four weeks.

thu: Tell a chatbot your channel's topic and ask it to split it into 4 series for the next 4 weeks.
